items.title: Johnny St. Cyr Interview, 1958-08-27
items.q: Interviewer mentions making a guitar for Lorenzo Stahls; Interviewee responds with fragmented speech ('You fixed one up for him too?') but does not confirm personal acquaintance or collaboration.

ctx.x: Oh, do you know that his last name, is it spelled, you know how it's spelled or pronounced exactly, is it Stahl or some people say Star, like the star up in the sky?
No, no, no, it's not like Star in the sky. It's, I think it's S-T-A-W-L-S. Stahls. Stahls.
Somebody said it might have a Z in. That sounds something like the way you said it.
